info.name: PlantUML Diagrams
info.summary: Your .puml files and README diagrams, drawn by your PlantUML server
info.description:
PlantUML Diagrams shows PlantUML where people already read it: a `.puml` file in the Files app, and a folder README that quotes or embeds one.
Point the app at a PlantUML server once. From then on a `.puml` file opens as a picture in the image viewer, right-click gives you a side-by-side editor with the diagram redrawing as you type, **+ New → Diagram** starts one, and a folder README shows its ```plantuml fences and `![](diagram.puml)` images as diagrams.
The app holds no diagrams of its own. A `.puml` is an ordinary Nextcloud file — share it, version it, trash it like any other.
📖 **[Documentation on GitHub](https://github.com/kubed-io/nextcloud-plantuml#readme)**
This is a community integration and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the PlantUML project. "PlantUML" is used here only to identify the software this app integrates with.
info.author: kubed-io
